recipes.title: Fresh Mint Cucumber Detox Juice
recipes.description: Hydrating, fat-burning green detox juice packed with cucumber, fresh mint, lemon, and ginger. Warm family wellness blend!
safetyTips: Wash mint leaves thoroughly under running water to remove any dirt.

steps.title: Prep Fresh Ingredients
steps.description: Peel cucumber (optional) and chop into coarse cubes. Wash fresh mint leaves and peel 1/2 inch ginger.
steps.tip: Keeping ingredients in fridge beforehand gives an icy refreshing juice!

steps.title: Blend Until Smooth
steps.description: Add cucumber, mint, ginger, 1 cup water, and lemon juice into your blender jar. Blend on HIGH for 45 seconds.
steps.tip: No blender? Use a hand immersion stick blender directly in a tall cup!

steps.title: Strain & Serve
steps.description: Pour through a mesh strainer into a glass. Add a pinch of black salt or honey.
steps.tip: Drink immediately for maximum digestion benefits.

recipes.title: Icy Watermelon Lime Refresher
recipes.description: Naturally sweet, seedless watermelon blitzed with fresh lime juice and ice. Super hydrating post-workout juice!
safetyTips: Be careful when slicing large watermelons; keep cutting board stable.

steps.title: Deseed & Cube Watermelon
steps.description: Chop watermelon into medium cubes. Remove large seeds with a fork.
steps.tip: Chilling watermelon cubes in freezer for 20 mins makes an instant slushie!

steps.title: Blend & Pour
steps.description: Add watermelon cubes, lime juice, mint leaves, and ice. Pulse 3 times until smooth. Pour into tall glasses!
steps.tip: Don't overblend or seeds turn bitter.

recipes.title: 35g Protein Chocolate Peanut Butter Shake
recipes.description: Ultimate muscle building post-workout protein milkshake packed with banana, oats, peanut butter, and cocoa/whey.
safetyTips: Ensure blender lid is securely closed before turning on machine.

steps.title: Load Blender Base
steps.description: Pour 1.5 cups cold milk into blender first. Add sliced banana, 3 tbsp oats, and 2 tbsp peanut butter.
steps.tip: Freezing sliced bananas in ziplock bags creates thick milkshake creaminess naturally!

steps.title: Add Protein Powder & Blend
steps.description: Add 1 scoop chocolate protein powder (or cocoa + honey). Blend on high speed for 60 seconds until creamy and frothy.
steps.tip: If shake is too thick, splash 2 tbsp extra milk!

recipes.title: Creamy Royal Mango Lassi Shake
recipes.description: Traditional probiotic mango yoghurt shake infused with cardamom and saffron. Refreshing cozy drink!
safetyTips: Use fresh yogurt so lassi tastes sweet and creamy, not sour.

steps.title: Combine Ingredients
steps.description: Add 1 cup mango pulp, 1 cup thick curd, 1/2 cup cold milk, 2 tbsp honey, and pinch of cardamom into blender jar.
steps.tip: Greek yogurt yields ultra-thick restaurant-style lassi!

steps.title: Blend 45 Seconds
steps.description: Blend on medium-high speed until completely smooth. Top with chopped pistachios or almonds!
steps.tip: Serve ice cold in tall copper or glass tumblers.

recipes.title: 28g Protein Paneer & Egg Bhurji / Scramble
recipes.description: High protein muscle builder combining crumbled paneer, eggs, onions, tomatoes, and Indian spices. Cozy family recipe!
safetyTips: Stir continuously on medium heat so paneer stays soft and moist.

steps.title: Sauté Veggies
steps.description: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in pan. Add chopped onions and tomatoes. Cook on MEDIUM flame for 2 minutes until tomatoes turn soft.
steps.tip: Add salt with veggies to draw out moisture fast!

steps.title: Add Eggs & Paneer
steps.description: Crack 2 eggs into pan, then add 100g crumbled paneer and spices. Stir continuously for 3-4 minutes until eggs set soft.
steps.tip: Turn off flame while scramble is slightly moist; residual heat cooks it to perfection.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt & Nut Protein Power Bowl
recipes.description: 25g protein breakfast/snack bowl with unsweetened Greek yogurt, almonds, walnuts, chia seeds, and honey.
safetyTips: Store chia seeds in airtight jar in cool cabinet.

steps.title: Assemble Bowl
steps.description: Scoop 200g thick Greek yogurt into serving bowl. Top with sliced almonds, walnuts, chia seeds, and drizzle honey.
steps.tip: Greek yogurt has 2x protein compared to regular curd!

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado & Cucumber Toast
recipes.description: Mashed ripe avocado with lemon juice, red pepper flakes, and crisp cucumber slices on bread.
safetyTips: Cut avocado carefully around pit; scoop flesh out with spoon.

steps.title: Mash Avocado
steps.description: Scoop 1/2 avocado into bowl. Add 1 tsp lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Mash with fork until creamy.
steps.tip: Lemon juice prevents avocado from turning brown!

steps.title: Spread & Top
steps.description: Spread creamy avocado onto bread. Top with thin cucumber slices and red chili flakes.
steps.tip: Use sourdough or multi-grain bread for extra fiber.

recipes.title: 5-Minute Protein Chana Chaat Bowl
recipes.description: Tangy protein snack bowl with boiled chickpeas, diced cucumber, tomatoes, lemon juice, and chaat spices. Zero cooking!
safetyTips: If using canned chickpeas, rinse thoroughly under water before using.

steps.title: Toss Ingredients
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, combine 1 cup chickpeas, chopped onions, tomatoes, chaat masala, lemon juice, and coriander. Mix well!
steps.tip: Great afternoon college snack or evening pre-workout meal!

recipes.title: 5-Minute Easy Egg Toast
recipes.description: A super quick, foolproof cozy breakfast for students & busy workers. No fancy equipment needed.
safetyTips: Keep stove flame on low-medium so eggs don't burn.

steps.title: Whisk the Eggs
steps.description: Crack 2 eggs into a small bowl. Add a pinch of salt and black pepper. Stir gently with a fork for 20 seconds until yellow and smooth.
steps.tip: Cracking the egg on a flat countertop prevents eggshells from falling into the bowl.

steps.title: Warm the Pan
steps.description: Place your pan on stove and turn heat to MEDIUM. Add 1 tsp of butter and wait until it melts completely.
steps.tip: If butter starts turning dark brown, reduce heat to LOW immediately.

steps.title: Cook the Toast & Eggs
steps.description: Pour whisked egg mixture into pan. Dip one bread slice, flip over so both sides are coated, and do the same for second slice. Cook 2 mins.
steps.tip: Cook eggs until soft, don't rush high heat!

recipes.title: No-Cook Veggie Paneer Roll
recipes.description: Zero stove cooking required! Fresh grated paneer wrapped with crunchy bell peppers & green chutney.
safetyTips: Ensure vegetables are washed well with clean water before slicing.

steps.title: Spread Sauce
steps.description: Lay tortilla flat on a clean plate. Spread 1 tbsp green chutney or mayo evenly in center.
steps.tip: Leave 1 inch around edge clear so it folds neatly without spilling.

steps.title: Add Filling & Roll
steps.description: Pile 1/2 cup grated paneer, sliced capsicum, and tomatoes along the middle line. Fold bottom up and roll tight!
steps.tip: Do not overfill or wrap might break while rolling.

recipes.title: 2-Minute Microwave Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.description: Craving dessert without baking in an oven? Soft eggless chocolate cake made directly inside a coffee mug.
safetyTips: Mug will be hot when removing from microwave. Use a cloth or glove!

steps.title: Mix & Microwave 60 Seconds
steps.description: Mix dry flour, sugar, cocoa, milk, and melted butter in mug until smooth. Microwave on HIGH for 60 seconds.
steps.tip: Do not overcook or cake becomes rubbery.

learnBasics.title: How to Boil Eggs Perfectly (Soft, Medium, Hard)
learnBasics.summary: Never guess egg boiling times again! Step-by-step time chart for beginners.
learnBasics.content:
### Egg Boiling Timer Matrix:
- **Soft-Boiled (Runny Yolk)**: 6 minutes in boiling water.
- **Medium-Boiled (Jammy Yolk)**: 7.5 minutes in boiling water.
- **Hard-Boiled (Firm Yolk)**: 9 to 10 minutes in boiling water.

### Golden Rules:
1. Always start with cold water covering eggs by 1 inch.
2. Bring water to boil on high heat, then turn down heat to medium simmer.
3. Immediately transfer cooked eggs to an **Ice Bath** (cold water + ice) for 3 minutes to stop cooking!

learnBasics.title: How to Cook Fluffy Rice Without Sticky Glue
learnBasics.summary: Master the 1:2 water ratio method on stove top.
learnBasics.content:
### 1:2 Water Ratio Method:
- 1 cup White Rice = 2 cups Water.
- Wash rice 2 times under running water until water is no longer super cloudy.

### Steps:
1. Combine washed rice and 2 cups water in pot.
2. Bring to boil without lid on HIGH flame.
3. Once boiling, turn flame to LOWEST setting, put lid ON, and simmer for **12 minutes**. Do NOT open lid!
4. Turn off heat and let sit covered for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork!

learnBasics.title: Kitchen Safety 101 for Absolute Beginners
learnBasics.summary: Essential safety rules to prevent knife cuts, oil splatters, and fire hazards.
learnBasics.content:
### Top 5 Kitchen Safety Rules:
1. **The Claw Grip**: Curve fingers inward like a bear claw when holding vegetables while chopping.
2. **Pan Handle Inward**: Turn stove handles inward towards back of stove.
3. **Never Water on Oil Fire**: If hot oil catches fire, cover with metal lid or baking soda. NEVER throw water!

tipsAndTricks.title: How to make thick creamy milkshakes without ice cream
tipsAndTricks.content: Peel ripe bananas, slice them, and freeze in ziplock bags! When blended with milk, frozen bananas create ultra-thick creamy texture naturally.

tipsAndTricks.title: Pre-workout vs Post-workout nutrition rules
tipsAndTricks.content: Pre-workout (30m before): Eat fast carbs like banana or watermelon juice. Post-workout (within 45m): Consume 25-30g protein (protein shake or egg/paneer scramble) to repair muscle fibers.
